cases.name: failed-burst
cases.review_note: Finding 只重复合成标记，遗漏 8 次失败；Hypothesis 反而称真实传感器发现，与输入及自身 uncertainty 矛盾。

cases.name: success-after-fail

cases.scope: LLM-assisted qualitative review of actual stored output; not a calibrated human gold-label score

cases.name: service-account

cases.scope: LLM-assisted qualitative review of actual stored output; not a calibrated human gold-label score

cases.name: unknown-user

cases.name: reconnects

cases.name: registered-scanner

cases.name: blocked-flow

cases.name: single-probe

cases.name: healthy-response

cases.name: server-error

cases.name: recovered-response

cases.name: missing-check
